meaning:
Φαρές, ὁ indecl. (Heb. פֶּרֶץ, Gen.38:29),
Peres: Mat.1:3, Luk.3:33.†

renderings.kjv: which was the son of Phares

elsewhere.note: Judah became the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar. Perez became the father of Hezron. Hezron became the father of Ram.
the son of Amminadab, the son of Aram, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,
